topic: The terms sheet's text field keeps macOS text services on
detail: SP-053's Replace Terms sheet is a SwiftUI TextEditor with autocorrection off, but macOS spell checking and text services (look-up, writing tools) still see what is typed. Terms never reach the model, a log or orchd's answers (INV-07), but a field that hands them to no system service would need an NSTextView wrapper with continuous spell checking and text services off. Low; raised by the SP-053 security review.
